clips.title: The story
paras: At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, a flask of water is gathered for Jennea Cannon in Stormwind. The mages will test it for signs of altered arcane currents in local water.

Jennea Cannon sends promising apprentices to collect water from Mirror Lake. The lake lies just southwest of the Stormwind Gate, and they fill a specially prepared flask at the base of its waterfall. The Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind is concerned that the world's mystic channels remain unsettled after catastrophic conflicts. Its mages will examine the sample for stray magical taint in the waterways used by people nearby.
